objective: Diagnosticar exactamente por que R91 130MID 2026-09-01..12 fallo con rc=1. Identificar dias pendientes, comparar encabezados POS contra Runtime y localizar tickets con encabezado cero y detalle monetario no explicado que puedan bloquear el extractor. Solo lectura.

queries.name: pos_daily_130mid_20260901_12
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(tr.apertura AS date) AS fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas,COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-09-01' AND tr.apertura<'2026-09-13' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0 GROUP BY CAST(tr.apertura AS date) ORDER BY fecha

queries.name: zero_header_unexplained_candidates
queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT CAST(tr.apertura AS date) AS fecha,ch.folio,CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS header_total FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-09-01' AND tr.apertura<'2026-09-13' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0), d AS (SELECT dc.foliodet AS folio,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS detalle_total,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0)<0 AND UPPER(ISNULL(p.descripcion,'')) LIKE '%FRANQUICIA%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS franquicia_negativa FROM cheqdet dc LEFT JOIN productos p ON p.idproducto=dc.idproducto GROUP BY dc.foliodet) SELECT h.fecha,h.folio,h.header_total,ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0) AS detalle_total,CAST(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta,ISNULL(d.franquicia_negativa,0) AS franquicia_negativa FROM h LEFT JOIN d ON d.folio=h.folio WHERE h.header_total=0 AND ABS(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0))>0.05 ORDER BY h.fecha,h.folio

queries.name: runtime_vs_existing_detail_130mid_20260901_12
queries.sql: WITH rt AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) ventas_runtime,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets_runtime,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax_runtime FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)>='2026-09-01' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)<'2026-09-13' GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)), dt_ticket AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,numero_ticket,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta_ticket,MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)>='2026-09-01' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)<'2026-09-13' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket), dt AS (SELECT fecha,SUM(venta_ticket) ventas_detalle,COUNT(*) tickets_detalle,SUM(pax_ticket) pax_detalle FROM dt_ticket GROUP BY fecha) SELECT rt.fecha,rt.ventas_runtime,ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0) ventas_detalle,CAST(rt.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0) AS decimal(19,4)) delta_ventas,rt.tickets_runtime,ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) tickets_detalle,rt.tickets_runtime-ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) delta_tickets,rt.pax_runtime,ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) pax_detalle,rt.pax_runtime-ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) delta_pax,CASE WHEN ABS(rt.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0))<=0.05 AND rt.tickets_runtime=ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) AND rt.pax_runtime=ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) THEN 'OK' ELSE 'PENDIENTE' END estado FROM rt LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.fecha=rt.fecha ORDER BY rt.fecha
